answer: At registration, each identity must deposit a 1 reef sum into their personal reef, providing their proof-of-work (POW) at summit time, where failure results in an instant rejection. During the epoch, agents from delta regions check the POW every 12 hours; a failed verification incurs a 2 reef fine for the non-compliant identity. Cloning multiple identities, attempting to exploit the verification system, would lead to a total of 8 reef being penalized in the reef sum for every 3 cloned identities caught, ensuring the attacker ends up 4 reef worse off.
